parameters.jsonBody:
=
{{
JSON.stringify({
  model: "openai/gpt-oss-120b",
  temperature: 0.2,
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: `You are Job Application Autopilot, a professional resume analyst and cover-letter writer.

OBJECTIVE:
Compare the resume against the exact job description and create an accurate analysis and personalized cover letter.

ACCURACY RULES:
- Use the exact job title and company name supplied in the form.
- Never invent personal details, qualifications, dates, experience, internships, achievements, projects, certifications, or profile links.
- Use only facts supported by the submitted form or resume.
- If form and resume details conflict, mention the discrepancy in reasoning.
- A skill missing from the resume is not proof the candidate lacks it.
- Calculate fit_score from 0 to 100 based on relevant evidence. Explain strengths and gaps.
- matching_skills must contain relevant skills supported by the resume.
- missing_skills must contain relevant job requirements not evidenced in the resume.

PERSONAL INFORMATION:
- Extract applicant_name, applicant_email, applicant_phone, linkedin_url, portfolio_url, github_url, education, and graduation_date from the resume or form only.
- Prefer the form value for applicant name and email.
- If a field is unavailable, return an empty string.
- Add missing profile information labels to missing_information.
- Do not invent or repair contact details or links.

COVER LETTER:
- Write a concise, professional cover letter for the exact job title and company.
- Use only verified information.
- If the name is unavailable, begin with Dear Hiring Team.
- Never include fake contact details or placeholders.

OUTPUT:
- Return valid JSON only, with no Markdown or commentary.
- fit_score must be a number from 0 to 100.
- matching_skills, missing_skills, and missing_information must be arrays of strings.
- All other fields must be strings.

Return exactly this schema:
{
  "applicant_name": "",
  "applicant_email": "",
  "applicant_phone": "",
  "linkedin_url": "",
  "portfolio_url": "",
  "github_url": "",
  "education": "",
  "graduation_date": "",
  "fit_score": 0,
  "reasoning": "",
  "matching_skills": [],
  "missing_skills": [],
  "missing_information": [],
  "cover_letter": ""
}`
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        "APPLICANT NAME FROM FORM:\n" +
        ($('Website Form Submission').first().json.body?.applicant_name || "") +
        "\nAPPLICANT EMAIL FROM FORM:\n" +
        ($('Website Form Submission').first().json.body?.applicant_email || "") +
        "\nJOB TITLE:\n" +
        ($('Website Form Submission').first().json.body?.job_title || "") +
        "\nCOMPANY NAME:\n" +
        ($('Website Form Submission').first().json.body?.company_name || "") +
        "\nJOB DESCRIPTION:\n" +
        ($('Website Form Submission').first().json.body?.job_description || "") +
        "\nRESUME TEXT:\n" +
        ($('Resume Text Extraction').first().json.text || "")
    }
  ]
})
}}

additionalFields.description: =Applicant: {{ $('Prepare Application Report').first().json.applicant_name }} Job: {{ $('Prepare Application Report').first().json.job_title }} Company: {{ $('Prepare Application Report').first().json.company_name }} Fit Score: {{ $('Prepare Application Report').first().json.fit_score }}/100 Applicant Email: {{ $('Prepare Application Report').first().json.applicant_email }}

parameters.subject: Your Resume Analysis — Please Try Again
parameters.message:
= {{ (() => { const data = $('Website Form Submission').first().json.body || {}; const name = data.applicant_name || 'Candidate'; const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '"': '"', "'": ''' }[c])); return `
JOB APPLICATION AUTOPILOT

We're on it!

An update about your resume analysis

Hello ${esc(name)},

Thank you for submitting your resume to Job Application Autopilot. Unfortunately, we couldn't complete your analysis right now because the AI service encountered a temporary error.

Analysis temporarily unavailable

Your resume match score and personalized cover letter have not been generated. Please try submitting your application again later.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Best regards,
Job Application Autopilot Team

This is an automated notification. Please try again later if your analysis could not be completed.

`; })() }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Your Job Application Analysis - ' + $('Website Form Submission').first().json.body.job_title }}
